Body.Content:
This series of five video-based modules explores topics including IoT device connectivity, IoT data communication strategies, use of AI at the edge, data processing considerations for IoT data, and IoT solutioning based on the Azure IoT reference architecture. For more details, read the blog post on the IoT Tech Community.

View the videos.
